note: Editorial notes on features whose printed Taḥbīr sentence leaves out a reader that both an-Nashr and al-Mabsūṭ name. They report the difference and change no claim. Keyed by item id. Other differences between the books are recorded in second-witness/compare-read.json only.

notes.u167878-1: The Taḥbīr sentence names Ḥafṣ, Ḥamza and Khalaf for the alif and nūn and gives the tāʾ to the rest, so al-Kisāʾī is shown with the rest. an-Nashr (vol. 2 p. 295) and al-Mabsūṭ both name al-Kisāʾī with the alif and nūn. The entry follows the Taḥbīr sentence as printed.
notes.u213568-1: The Taḥbīr sentence names Ibn ʿĀmir, Ḥafṣ, al-Kisāʾī and Khalaf for the plural and gives the singular to the rest, so Ḥamza is shown with the rest. an-Nashr (vol. 2 p. 345) and al-Mabsūṭ both name Ḥamza with the plural. The entry follows the Taḥbīr sentence as printed.
notes.u232865-1: The Taḥbīr sentence names Nāfiʿ, Abū Jaʿfar and Ibn ʿĀmir for the plural and gives the singular to the rest, so Ḥafṣ is shown with the rest. an-Nashr (vol. 2 p. 367) and al-Mabsūṭ both name Ḥafṣ with the plural. The entry follows the Taḥbīr sentence as printed.
